description: This file defines functions and structures for handling bitmap objects in the FreeType font rendering library, including initialization, copying, emboldening, conversion, ownership management, and cleanup of FT_Bitmap objects.

methods.name: FT_Bitmap_Init
methods.description: Initializes a pointer to an FT_Bitmap structure.

methods.name: FT_Bitmap_Copy
methods.description: Copies a bitmap into another one.

methods.name: FT_Bitmap_Embolden
methods.description: Embosses a bitmap to make it thicker.

methods.name: FT_Bitmap_Convert
methods.description: Converts a bitmap to a different pixel depth and alignment.

methods.name: FT_GlyphSlot_Own_Bitmap
methods.description: Ensures a glyph slot owns its bitmap.
